Title: Public preview: Cluster auto-upgrade now respects planned maintenance windows

Body.Content:
Planned maintenance allows you to schedule weekly maintenance windows for updates to minimize workload impact. Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) now supports the ability for you to use cluster auto-upgrade with planned maintenance windows. This allows you to schedule your automatic upgrades during a specific time slot that you allocated.

Learn more about auto-upgrade in AKS.

Learn more about planned maintenance.
